prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce one finished high fidelity iOS app screen concept for Minor AI, not a website, no code. PORTRAIT image about 1024x2048. One front-facing premium iPhone mockup, very thin dark titanium border, straight-on no perspective; entire phone visible with small even 36px outer margins, phone screen dominates. Native 9:41 status bar, Dynamic Island, bottom safe area. Crisp SF Pro-like typography, realistic 393x852 pt app scale: body 16-17pt, headings 30-34pt, controls 44pt minimum. Russian text rendered accurately. No text or titles outside phone. No extra devices, no watermarks, no invented logos, no prices or user-count claims. Brand name is plain text Minor AI. This is a new design exploration, do not copy old screen layouts. Calm restrained hierarchy, usable touch targets, no tiny illegible filler, no endless pills. Product: AI assistant plus mind maps, slides, tasks, study. Content throughout this series is project 'Запуск подкаста'.
FOCUS DESIGN BIBLE: premium iOS-native dark utility; screen background #121212, surfaces #232323, very fine #363636 dividers. White headlines and white primary action buttons with black text. Mint #2FFF9E only selected indicators, subdued branch colors mint #5EF0B0, sky #7CC4FF, lilac #C9A2FF, pink #FC86C3, sun #FFD66B, coral #FC9886. SF Pro, precise left-aligned 24pt margins, 16pt body, compact restrained 16pt radii. Very faint dot texture only inside map previews. No glass, no decorative glow clouds. Flat lists, bottom contextual sheet, subtle segmented control, message composer are core components. Fine-grid and tiny directional marks only; calm tab transitions and sheet rise feel. Outer backdrop #242625.
SCREEN HOME. Below status, header Minor AI with small circular account button. Large two-line headline 'С чего начнём?'. One substantial quiet composer surface with placeholder 'Тема, ссылка или вопрос', paperclip lower left, microphone and white circular upward arrow lower right. Below, three compact source shortcuts 'Файл', 'Голос', 'Все источники' in a single visually light row, not giant cards. Section 'Продолжить' with one wide modest project preview showing a small actual mind map at left, title 'Запуск подкаста', subline 'Карта · 12 идей', small disclosure. Below two flat rows 'История дизайна' / 'Учёба' and 'План недели' / 'Карта'. Small section 'Сегодня' with two checkbox task rows 'Выбрать тему выпуска', 'Записать вступление'. Fixed native bottom tabs 'Главная', 'Карты', 'Чат', 'Сегодня', first active with mint indicator and white label. Exactly one composer, roomy readable layout, no date widgets or statistics.
